description: ROLE/GRANT/REVOKE/annotation/tablespace/large-object/ALTER SYSTEM acceptance on postgresql17 (#130): privilege chain (roles, grants, default privileges, owned objects, comments, security labels) plus tablespace/large-object/alter-system boundaries execute natively.

ddl_steps.name: create roles
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE ROLE t47_admin LOGIN; CREATE ROLE t47_app LOGIN PASSWORD NULL; CREATE ROLE t47_read NOLOGIN

ddl_steps.name: create role options
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE ROLE t47_mgr WITH LOGIN CREATEDB IN ROLE t47_admin

ddl_steps.name: user/group aliases
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE USER t47_u; CREATE GROUP t47_g

ddl_steps.name: alter role options
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER ROLE t47_app WITH NOSUPERUSER NOINHERIT CONNECTION LIMIT 5

ddl_steps.name: alter role rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER ROLE t47_u RENAME TO t47_u2

ddl_steps.name: alter role set param
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER ROLE t47_app SET work_mem = '16MB'

ddl_steps.name: grant role membership
ddl_steps.sql: GRANT t47_read TO t47_app WITH ADMIN OPTION

ddl_steps.name: fixture objects
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE SCHEMA t47; CREATE TABLE t47.t (id int PRIMARY KEY, v text); CREATE SEQUENCE t47.s; CREATE FUNCTION t47.f() RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql AS 'SELECT 1'

ddl_steps.name: grant table privs
ddl_steps.sql: GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON t47.t TO t47_app WITH GRANT OPTION

ddl_steps.name: grant columns
ddl_steps.sql: GRANT SELECT (id), UPDATE (v) ON t47.t TO t47_read

ddl_steps.name: grant all tables in schema
ddl_steps.sql: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA t47 TO t47_read

ddl_steps.name: grant sequences/functions/db/schema/types
ddl_steps.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SEQUENCE t47.s TO t47_read; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION t47.f() TO t47_read; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA t47 TO t47_read

ddl_steps.name: grant database/tablespace/large-objects
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLESPACE t47_ts LOCATION '/tmp/t47_ts'; GRANT CREATE ON TABLESPACE t47_ts TO t47_app; GRANT CREATE ON DATABASE postgres TO t47_app; GRANT SELECT ON LARGE OBJECT 1 TO t47_read

ddl_steps.name: grant granted-by/set
ddl_steps.sql: GRANT SELECT ON t47.t TO t47_app GRANTED BY CURRENT_USER

ddl_steps.name: revoke grant option
ddl_steps.sql: REVOKE GRANT OPTION FOR INSERT ON t47.t FROM t47_app

ddl_steps.name: revoke privileges
ddl_steps.sql: REVOKE UPDATE (v) ON t47.t FROM t47_read; REVOKE SELECT ON t47.t FROM t47_app CASCADE

ddl_steps.name: revoke role
ddl_steps.sql: REVOKE t47_read FROM t47_app

ddl_steps.name: alter default privileges
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE t47_admin IN SCHEMA t47 GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO t47_read

ddl_steps.name: alter default privileges revoke
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE t47_admin IN SCHEMA t47 REVOKE SELECT ON TABLES FROM t47_read

ddl_steps.name: comment objects
ddl_steps.sql: COMMENT ON TABLE t47.t IS 'fixture'; COMMENT ON COLUMN t47.t.id IS 'pk col'; COMMENT ON SCHEMA t47 IS 'scope'

ddl_steps.name: comment null
ddl_steps.sql: COMMENT ON TABLE t47.t IS NULL

ddl_steps.name: security label
ddl_steps.sql: SECURITY LABEL FOR selinux ON TABLE t47.t IS 'system_u:object_r:sepgsql_table_t:s0'

ddl_steps.name: security label provider attempt
ddl_steps.sql: SECURITY LABEL ON TABLE t47.t IS 'x'

ddl_steps.name: mkdir tablespace dir
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t47_dirprobe (x int); COPY t47_dirprobe TO PROGRAM 'mkdir -p /tmp/t47_ts'; DROP TABLE t47_dirprobe

ddl_steps.name: tablespace lifecycle
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLESPACE t47_ts LOCATION '/tmp/t47_ts'

ddl_steps.name: alter tablespace options/rename/owner
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLESPACE t47_ts SET (seq_page_cost = 0.9); ALTER TABLESPACE t47_ts RENAME TO t47_ts2

ddl_steps.name: drop tablespace
ddl_steps.sql: DROP TABLESPACE t47_ts2

ddl_steps.name: large object alter
ddl_steps.sql: SELECT lo_create(0); ALTER LARGE OBJECT 0 OWNER TO t47_app

ddl_steps.name: language lifecycle
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TRUSTED PROCEDURAL LANGUAGE t47_lang HANDLER plpgsql_call_handler INLINE plpgsql_inline_handler VALIDATOR plpgsql_validator

ddl_steps.name: alter language rename/owner
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER LANGUAGE t47_lang RENAME TO t47_lang2

ddl_steps.name: drop language
ddl_steps.sql: DROP LANGUAGE t47_lang2

ddl_steps.name: alter system set
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER SYSTEM SET application_name = 't47_golden'

ddl_steps.name: alter system reset
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER SYSTEM RESET application_name

ddl_steps.name: drop owned
ddl_steps.sql: DROP OWNED BY t47_app CASCADE

ddl_steps.name: reassign owned
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE ROLE t47_new LOGIN; REASSIGN OWNED BY t47_mgr TO t47_new

ddl_steps.name: drop schema
ddl_steps.sql: DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS t47 CASCADE

ddl_steps.name: drop roles
ddl_steps.sql: DROP ROLE t47_mgr, t47_app, t47_read, t47_admin, t47_u2, t47_g, t47_new

post_state_check.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE grantee='ghost_t47'
